body.message: Thank you for your response.On Wed, Apr 8, 2026 at 16:53 Chahana | fäm Living <deposit@famliving.com> wrote:Hello Ms. Aida,Thank you for providing the bank details. We will update the finance team accordingly. We sincerely apologize for the delay, and as soon as the finance team initiates the process, we will update you.Thank you for your patience.Kind regards,Chahana T.On Wed, Apr 8, 2026 12:10 PM,  wrote:Dear Aida Afrazi,This confirms that we received your email and registered it as ticket #940912407. You can always reply to this email to add additional information. Meanwhile, please note the following:If you paid your security deposit with a payment link before or on arrival, your deposit will be refunded within seven working days.If you paid your security deposit with a credit/debit card or via bank transfer on arrival with your guest relation executive, please expect the deposit to be refunded within a maximum of 14 working days. If you paid your security deposit in cash, it would be refunded in cash within 7 working days.If you have stayed for more than 15 days, then your booking would be considered as a long-term booking. All long-term bookings will be refunded within 14 working days as well.The refund will be processed in full through your preferred mode of payment, subject to a property inspection.To ensure a prompt refund, we kindly request you provide your preferred mode of refund (credit card, local bank account, cash, or international wire) to your dedicated guest relations executive as soon as possible. This will facilitate the timely return of funds to our valued guests.Below are the necessary fields and information required for a swift refund by bank transfer:Booking reference number:Beneficiary Name: Beneficiary Address:Beneficiary Bank Name:Beneficiary Bank Account Details (IBAN):Swift Code: Beneficiary Bank Address:Currency of Account:Sort Code:Kinds regards,Team fäm LivingOn Wed, Apr 8, 2026 12:10 PM, aidaafrazi33@gmail.com wrote:Dear Fam Living,I hope you are doing well.I rented the apartment (Upside 2806) from you for the months of January and February 2026. On 20 December 2025, I paid AED 3,000 as a security deposit.I checked out on 1 March 2026; however, I have not yet received the refund. I would appreciate it if you could kindly update me on the status and let me know when I can expect to receive it. Please also find the relevant documents attached.For your reference, here are my bank details for the refund:Booking Reference Number: #GY-bQqvZkhN  Beneficiary Name: Aida Afrazi  Beneficiary Address: Dubai, Business Bay, Upside Living by SRG, Unit 2603  Beneficiary Bank Name: Mashreq Bank  IBAN: AE730330000019101748382  SWIFT Code: BOMLAEAD  Bank Address: Dubai, UAE  Currency: AED  Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to your prompt response.Kind regards,  Aida Afrazi
